title: Finance & Payroll Accounts Assistant - TEMP TO PERM
description:
Finance & Payroll Accounts Assistant - TEMP TO PERM

Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday
Location: Bourton-on-the-Water
Salary: Up to £35,000
Working pattern: Office-based, with some flexibility around start and finish times

The Role

We are looking for an organised and detail-focused Finance & Payroll Accounts Assistant. The role combines responsibility for accurate weekly payroll preparation with finance, accounts and general administrative support.

The key focus is compiling, checking and validating employee hours before weekly payroll is processed. This is not an end-to-end payroll position; payroll processing, tax and final payroll preparation are handled by an established payroll specialist.

Key Responsibilities
- Compile and validate weekly employee hours, including variable hours, pay rates, sickness, holidays and other payroll adjustments.
- Review time-recording information and compare reports across multiple systems.
- Investigate discrepancies, missing or incorrect information and liaise with managers to resolve issues.
- Ensure payroll data is accurate, complete and correctly allocated ahead of the weekly payroll deadline.
- Support Finance with payroll reporting, reconciliations, financial records and general accounts administration.
- Handle relevant cash, petty cash and payment administration.
- Maintain accurate payroll, financial and employee records, spreadsheets and internal systems.
- Respond to payroll, finance and employee queries professionally, working collaboratively with Finance, HR and management.
- Provide general administrative support to the wider business as required.

What We're Looking For
- Previous payroll experience, with a proven understanding of payroll processes and experience collating and/or checking payroll data.
- Strong Excel skills, including confidence working with formulas, checking formula accuracy and analysing spreadsheets.
- Experience analysing data from multiple systems or reports and confidently interrogating information to identify discrepancies or errors.
- Understanding of hours worked, pay rates, gross pay, deductions, net pay, holiday, sickness and different working arrangements.
- Experience in basic finance and accounts administration, including maintaining financial records, reconciliations and cash-related queries.
- Excellent attention to detail, numerical accuracy and a methodical approach.
- Comfortable working to a weekly payroll cycle and fixed deadlines while maintaining accuracy in a busy environment.
- Strong organisation and prioritisation skills, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of deadlines.
- Good communication skills and confidence liaising with employees and managers.

Working Arrangements

The position is predominantly office-based, Monday to Friday, with some flexibility around start and finish times, provided business requirements and weekly payroll deadlines are met.

The role works across Finance, HR and management, requiring effective communication and collaboration.

Benefits
- Competitive salary up to £35,000.
- 20 days' holiday plus Bank Holidays.
- Pension scheme.
- Lifestyle benefits and retail discounts.
- Employee Assistance Programme.
- Career development opportunities.
- Option to purchase additional annual leave.
- Electric vehicle salary-sacrifice scheme.
- Cycle-to-work scheme.

To Be Considered

Please email me the following information:
- How many years' payroll experience you have.
- Your level of Excel experience.
- Your location and how you would travel to Bourton-on-the-Water.
- Your salary expectations.
- Your availability to start.

title: Finance Officer (Income & Debtors)
description:
Finance Officer (Income & Debtors)

Gloucester - Hybrid (Flexible Working)

£19,527.44 per annum

Temporary (Maternity Cover up to 12 months), Part Time (24 hours per week)

Part-time and flexible working, making this an ideal opportunity for those seeking greater flexibility around other commitments.

Did you know that 9% of homes in Gloucester are owned and managed by GCH? We're passionate about Gloucester and believe that everyone deserves a home they can be proud of, where they can thrive and be healthy.

We're now seeking a Finance Officer (Income & Debtors) to play a key role in maintaining strong financial controls and effective income management across the organisation. You'll be responsible for ensuring customer accounts and debtor records are accurate, up to date and fully maintained, supporting both financial reporting and income collection activities.

You will raise debtor invoices accurately and promptly across all Group companies, helping to ensure income is collected efficiently and financial information remains reliable and complete. The role also supports the reconciliation of rent accounting and rental income transactions, ensuring compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements.

Working closely with colleagues across the business, you will monitor and report on debtor balances, providing valuable insight to support debt management and cashflow forecasting. In addition, you will assist with internal and external audit processes by maintaining accurate financial records and demonstrating compliance with key financial controls, policies and procedures.

We'd like you to have
- Good understanding of accounts receivable, debtor management and financial administration processes.
- Strong numerical and reconciliation skills to process and maintain accurate financial records.
- Awareness of the importance of financial accuracy and reconciliation processes within a finance environment.
- Strong systems skills to process financial transactions and maintain accurate records across finance and housing systems.
- Knowledge of VAT requirements and financial controls relevant to processing customer invoices and payments.
- Excellent attention to detail to ensure accuracy across invoices, postings and customer accounts.
- AAT Level 2 qualification is advantageous.

Closing Date: 22nd October 2026

Interviews to be held week commencing 26th October 2026

GCH reserve the right to bring the closing date forward should enough quality applications be received prior to the current closing date.

GCH is committed to equal opportunities. We actively encourage applications from all sections of our community, particularly those with lived experience of our work.

We celebrate the diverse nature of our customers and colleagues, striving to develop diverse teams where everyone can be their authentic self through an inclusive, family friendly, flexible and fun culture.

At GCH, we Adapt, weInspire, we Own it and we Care. We live by our values and are dedicated to delivering on our commitment to customers . If that sounds like you, we'd be delighted to hear from you!

title: French speaking Payroll & HR Coordinator
description:
Job Title: French speaking Payroll & HR Coordinator

Location: Cirencester, hybrid after probation

Contract: Permanent, full-time, Monday - Friday: 8.30am - 5pm with early finishes on Fridays

Salary: £40,000-45,000 DOE + discretionary annual bonus

Our growing international client is a leader in the medtech industry and is on the lookout for a French speaking Payroll & HR Coordinator professional to join them during their exciting growth period!

In this role, you'll be supporting the accurate and timely processing of payroll, focussing on the French market, acting as a first point of contact for payroll and benefits queries from employees and managers, and supporting the company's global HR department.

Why join:
- An annual salary of £40,000-45,000 DOE + discretionary annual bonus
- Join a global, leading company during their growth period and make a direct impact on healthcare
- Excellent opportunities for growth and progression, including support with achieving your CIPP
- Free breakfast and canteen lunches with hot and cold meals
- Hybrid working following successful completion of probationary period, 3x days on-site
- Generous pension, going up to 9.7% after 18 months
- Private medical insurance with BUPA for you and your family
- Passionate, friendly, collaborative and international company culture with a shared goal
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- And more!

As the French speaking Payroll & HR Coordinator, you'll:
- Support the accurate and timely processing of payroll, focussing on the French market
- Maintain employee and payroll data, ensuring accuracy and compliance
- Process payroll changes, including new starters, leavers, salary adjustments, benefits and absences
- Act as a first point of contact for payroll and benefits queries from employees and managers
- Administer employee benefits and support monthly payroll reporting
- Assist with payroll audits, reconciliations, and HR administration tasks
- Collaborate with HR, Finance and external payroll providers to ensure smooth operations

Who we're looking for:
- Native-level French speaker with fluent English
- 2+ years of experience in French payroll processes and legislation
- High level of attention to detail
- Excellent communication skills
- Solution-based approach

Candidates must hold full right to work status for the UK, without requiring sponsorship for the foreseeable future.

Please be advised CVs will be treated in the strictest of confidence and that your application will not be forwarded without your permission.

We aim to respond promptly; however, due to the high level of applications, we are only able to contact candidates to applicants whose experience closely matches our client's requirements.

title: HR & Payroll Administrator
description:
HR & Payroll Administrator Full-time Permanent 39 Hours per Week £28,500 - £30,000 per annum

Are you an experienced HR and Payroll Administrator looking for a varied role within a professional and supportive business environment?Pertemps are recruiting for an HR & Payroll Administrator to provide accurate and efficient payroll and HR administrative support. Reporting to the HR Manager, you will play a key role in maintaining employee records, processing payroll information, and supporting HR administration throughout the employee lifecycle.

The Role
Working as an HR & Payroll Administrator, you will provide accurate and timely payroll and HR administrative support, ensuring employee data, payroll information and HR documentation are maintained in line with company procedures and statutory requirements.This role is focused on administration and processing activities and does not involve providing HR policy, employee relations or people management advice.

Key Responsibilities
- Process monthly payroll inputs, including starters, leavers, pay changes, overtime, absences and expenses
- Liaise with the payroll bureau to resolve payroll queries and meet payroll deadlines
- Administer SSP, SMP, SPP, SAP, P45s, P60s and pension auto-enrolment processes
- Maintain accurate employee records and HR system data
- Manage new starter and leaver administration, including right-to-work checks, references and contracts
- Produce standard employment documentation and routine HR/payroll reports
- Maintain absence, holiday, training and certification records
- Ensure all employee information is handled in line with GDPR and company policies

Candidate Requirements
- Previous experience within a payroll and/or HR administration role
- Good understanding of payroll processes and statutory payroll requirements
- Experience using HR/payroll systems such as Sage, iTrent, BrightHR or similar
- Strong Excel skills and excellent attention to detail
- Knowledge of right-to-work checks and HR administration procedures
- GCSEs (or equivalent) including Maths and English at Grade C/4 or above
- Strong organisational and communication skills
- Ability to maintain confidentiality and manage deadlines effectively

What's on Offer
- Permanent, full-time opportunity
- Salary of £28,500 - £30,000 per annum
- Professional and supportive working environment
- Varied role combining both HR and payroll responsibilities
- Opportunity to develop and grow within an established business
